title: Improving On-board Shape Models Using Sun Sensors and Implicit Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.24976v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose an original, end-to-end approach to generate and refine the onboard 3D shape model of irregular small bodies, such as asteroids, using only low-cost Sun sensor eclipse data and coarse a priori knowledge, tailored for resource-constrained missions like CubeSats. Leveraging EclipseNets, a differentiable neural model of eclipse boundaries, our pipeline first refines 2D silhouettes by learning from real-time entry and exit events during spacecraft orbits, avoiding the limitations of traditional imaging or lidar in bandwidth-starved environments. These silhouettes then supervise a compact neural signed-distance field with periodic activations, enabling incremental updates to a high-fidelity implicit geometry representation capable of capturing fine-scale features and concavities. In simulations of the body Eros under realistic orbital dynamics, the method increases silhouette IoU from 0.70 to 0.87 and produces coherent 3D reconst

translated_title: 利用太阳敏感器与隐式表示改进星载形状模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种原创的端到端方法，仅利用低成本的太阳敏感器日食掩蔽数据和粗糙的先验知识，来生成和改进不规则小天体（如小行星）的星载三维形状模型，专为资源受限的任务（如立方星）量身定制。借助EclipseNets——一个可微分的日食边界神经模型，我们的流程首先通过学习航天器轨道运行期间的实时进入和退出事件来精化二维轮廓，从而避免了传统成像或激光雷达在带宽匮乏环境中的局限性。随后，这些轮廓监督一个具有周期性激活的紧凑神经符号距离场，实现对高保真隐式几何表示的增量更新，能够捕捉细尺度特征和凹陷结构。在真实轨道动力学条件下对小行星Eros的仿真中，该方法将轮廓IoU从0.70提升至0.87，并产生连贯的三维重建结果。
tldr: 该方法仅利用太阳敏感器日食掩蔽数据与可微分神经模型EclipseNets，通过精化二维轮廓并监督周期性激活的神经符号距离场，实现小行星等不规则小天体星载三维形状模型的端到端生成与改进，将轮廓IoU从0.70提升至0.87。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an end-to-end approach that uses only low-cost Sun sensor eclipse data and the differentiable neural model EclipseNets to refine 2D silhouettes and supervise a periodically-activated neural signed-distance field, enabling onboard generation and refinement of high-fidelity 3D shape models of irregular small bodies such as asteroids, improving silhouette IoU from 0.70 to 0.87.
